BasinSettings.description:
What ``wadi2d basin`` needs beyond the job: a part of the job, so the run folder records how its basin was made.

The run never reads it: ``job_hash`` leaves it out, and the basin file's own bytes are what a checkpoint must match.

lag_method.description: Lag of a generated subbasin. 'nrcs': the NRCS watershed lag (NEH 630 chapter 15) on the longest flow length, the curve number and the mean land slope. 'hms_kirpich': 0.474 x Kirpich's time of concentration on the longest flow length and the 10-85 slope, the rule the 18 lags of the Block 2 HEC-HMS model follow to 0.3 % (W24). On Block 2 at 100 yr, NRCS gave 1.05 to 1.58 x the HMS peaks at the five dams and this rule 0.88 to 0.98; no gauge says which is right. Applied when the basin is generated: generate again after changing it
